relation_vocabulary.label: pursues
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A Project works toward a Goal.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Not Goal achievement or execution authority.

relation_vocabulary.label: maintained by
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A bounded Language is maintained through a named recurring practice.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: The Discipline does not become or define the Language.

relation_vocabulary.label: consumed by
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A product capability uses the source business object as input.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Consumption does not transfer meaning ownership.

relation_vocabulary.label: produces
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A product capability creates a candidate product output.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: This local business relation is not DomainSpec Operation-to-Event produces and does not imply acceptance.

relation_vocabulary.label: requires
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A business rule must hold for the source capability to remain valid.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Not proof that the rule is implemented.

relation_vocabulary.label: proposed realization of
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system candidate is proposed as one realization of part of a business capability.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Not implementation, runtime acceptance, semantic equivalence, or conformance evidence.

relation_vocabulary.label: supports practice
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system candidate is intended to support a named recurring business practice.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: The practice is not executable authority or an implementation algorithm.

relation_vocabulary.label: supports goal
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system candidate may contribute bounded evidence or behavior toward a Goal.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Supporting a Goal is not achieving it.

relation_vocabulary.label: supports outcome
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system responsibility is intended to contribute to a business outcome.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Not measured outcome evidence.

relation_vocabulary.label: traced to
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system record preserves its link to the business meaning it represents.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Traceability is not identity or semantic equivalence.

relation_vocabulary.label: constrained by
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system candidate must preserve a business rule.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: A design relation is not proof that the constraint is enforced.

relation_vocabulary.label: composed of
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: The source system aggregate coordinates the target component or interface.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Not code ownership, process topology, or deployed composition.

relation_vocabulary.label: coordinates
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A runtime component coordinates the lifecycle of a session aggregate.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Runtime and Session remain separate identities and responsibilities.

relation_vocabulary.label: has state
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A session aggregate owns one current state value.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: The aggregate is not the state value or persistence store.

relation_vocabulary.label: persists
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: The source runtime preserves the target state across interruption.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Not a storage-engine choice, durability proof, or permission to retain private state.

relation_vocabulary.label: contains
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A session state keeps a typed record as part of one bounded session.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Not authority inheritance or identity collapse.

relation_vocabulary.label: renders
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: An interface shows a projection of one stable record.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: The interface does not own a second truth source.

relation_vocabulary.label: selects next
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A transition engine selects the next stable Question Record from explicit input and current state.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Not semantic ownership, automatic correctness, or permission to skip unresolved work.

relation_vocabulary.label: records
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A transition engine records an explicit Answer Record while deriving a new state.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Recording an Answer is not making an owner decision or granting authority.

relation_vocabulary.label: reads reviewed state
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: An emitter consumes state that has been presented for explicit review.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Review presentation is not owner acceptance or semantic promotion.

relation_vocabulary.label: emits
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: An emitter creates a system-side candidate artifact preview or record.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: The emitter is not the emitted artifact, and emission is not acceptance.

relation_vocabulary.label: projects candidate of
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system artifact is a candidate projection of a business product output.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: The projection is not an accepted business artifact, promotion, publication, or execution.

relation_vocabulary.label: specified by
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A proposed system boundary is described by one candidate Runtime Contract artifact.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Specification is not contract acceptance, implementation admission, or conformance.

relation_vocabulary.label: accepts
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system boundary accepts one typed record as explicit input.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Accepted input shape is not an accepted command result or authority decision.

relation_vocabulary.label: produces view
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system boundary deterministically produces one transport-neutral read model.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: The view is not state ownership, transport, or a second truth source.

relation_vocabulary.label: projects
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A read-only system view projects one underlying stable record.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Projection is not identity, mutation, or separate ownership of meaning.

relation_vocabulary.label: designed to observe
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: An experiment frame is designed to observe one bounded product outcome without claiming the observation exists.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Experiment design is not a run, finding, conclusion, or Goal achievement.

relation_vocabulary.label: uses fixture
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: An experiment frame selects one bounded business-language asset as its semantic fixture.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Fixture selection does not redefine, accept, or exhaust the source Language.
